summary.headline: Astrology, Lots, and Mazounates
summary.text: Astrological and divinatory topics include planetary nature, warfare with the Moon in Leo, determining zodiacal signs from names, thunder and lightning, conception and memorial days, lots for judgment, battle victory, theft, and fast or nefast days. The entry then describes folios 18–31 of interrogations and patristic excerpts, followed by a philosophical poem on astral sand divination by the Persian Mazounates, translated into Roman language by the monk Arsenios for Theodora in 1266.
